Production dependency audit (RED-001-195, job `pnpm-audit`): needs registry access; both CI and verify-enterprise.sh --security run it as non-blocking advisory and preserve evidence.

Workers domain gate naming the RED-001-142 jobs/config packages explicitly; CI's go-test job already runs `go -C apps/api test ./...`, a superset covering those packages.
